resolverEnabled.description: Resolve identities across sources: key connector entities, gather the user's accounts, and adjudicate likely duplicates.

selfNames.description: Names the user goes by. The first becomes the label of the user's own Person entity.

selfEmails.description: Email addresses that belong to the user, besides the connected mail account.

selfHandles.description: The user's accounts as kind:value, e.g. github:octocat or linkedin:in/octocat. Connected Discord accounts are added automatically.

maxAdjudicationsPerRun.description: Maximum queued identity pairs the model decides per run (eight per request).

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for identity adjudication.
